description:
Run the frozen allocated `BitMatrix::matvec` cells and commit the current fused AND-popcount production baseline.

## Background

The measurement covers row strides of 8, 9, 63, 64, and 65 words plus neighboring dimensions and declared cache regimes. The scalar four-accumulator route is a semantic/reference arm; the retained fused SIMD route is the production comparator.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A committed receipt contains raw samples, exact commands, frozen matrix/vector identities, append-only execution log, runtime provenance, statistical summary, and acceptance interpretation for the dense-matvec cells.
- [hard] REQ-02: Exact parity output, canonical bit indexing, zero tail padding, and declared boundary semantics match the scalar reference.
- [hard] REQ-03: Annotated release assembly and profiles attribute observed costs to allocation, fused kernel work, dependencies, instruction mix, spills, cache traffic, or bandwidth.

## Notes

Run only in the benchmark window on the prepared host under the full-host wrapper.
title: Record the dense-matvec baseline
